turns.reply: I fixed the infinite loop in `Text.append` (`rich/text.py`): appending a `Text` to itself now terminates, because the span list is snapshotted before it is extended. Self-appending `'ab'` with a span now gives `'abab'` with four correct spans, and `tests/test_text.py` passes (108 tests). The patch is submitted.
